text:
Maria: Seeing a ton of GHA queue throttle for evals PR matrix. Jobs stuck with 'waiting for a self-hosted runner' and then 'Resource quota exceeded'. Anyone else?
CI-Bot: org-level runner quota reached (120 concurrent). Auto-scaling can't start more runners until warm-up. log_id=ci_2005_q1
Ajay: Yup. Matrix blew up to 30 shards per PR after the shard-split change — that spike explains the quota hit.
Kevin: We should cap PR matrices. Nightly can be full but PR should be smoke: 3-4 shards by default.
Sophie: Agreed. Quick patch suggestion: reduce default matrix for PRs and add job-level concurrency.
Maria: Quick mitigation I'm going to push: add `concurrency:
  group: evals-pr-${{ github.head_ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
` and limit `strategy: matrix: fail-fast: false` + set `max-parallel: 6` on the job. Also set default matrix shards=4 for PRs.
Ajay: Also plan a fallback flow: if we see 'Resource quota exceeded' or consistent 429s, have a tiny action that POSTs to our Buildkite eval webhook to run a smoke.
Kevin: GH Actions won't let us change their retry behavior; we need client-side requeueing in eval-runner. It can detect 429 and split remaining shards into smaller jobs.
Sophie: I'll open PR with the GHA changes. Sample snippet I'll add:
```
jobs:
  run-evals:
    concurrency:
      group: evals-pr-${{ github.head_ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    strategy:
      matrix:
        shard: [0,1,2,3]
      max-parallel: 6
```
Maria: For longer term Ajay, can you add logic in eval-runner to detect 429 and requeue to alternate endpoint (buildkite) with metadata (commit, eval_set) and emit metric 'eval.fallback_count'?
Ajay: Yes. Plan:
- detect 403/429 in GH API responses
- exponential backoff retry up to 3 times
- if still failing, POST to /hooks/bk-eval with payload {commit, eval_set, shards}
- emit metrics: eval.fallback_count, eval.retry_count
I'll file a PR for the runner today.
Jordan: One more operational ask: ops can bump self-hosted capacity by ~20 if we open INFRA ticket.
Maria: Filed INFRA-842 for runner scale + request. Ops assigned.
Kevin: Also update eval dashboards to show run platform (gha vs buildkite) and fallback_reason so we don't miss gating flakiness.
Sophie: I'll add a 'runner' tag in metrics and include 'fallback_reason' dimension.
CI-Bot: Deploy note: merging #2345 will change matrix defaults. Monitor queue for 2 hours after merge and ping this thread if we see >10 queued jobs.
Maria: :thumbsup: rolling patch now. Will follow up with PR link and heatmap of queued jobs.
